title: A hit implies reachability
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph, and let $s,t$ be vertices. If a finite sequence of neighbor indices, followed from $s$, visits $t$ (including a visit at the starting vertex), then there is a finite adjacency path from $s$ to $t$.
hypotheses_covered: The sequence of neighbor indices visits t from s
